verdict.rationale: Unleash documents activation strategies that enable features for certain users. It cites granting access to internal users alongside a percentage rollout, and targeting rules built on user IDs and emails. Segments let those constraint sets be reused across flags. Explicit exclusion of individual users and a concrete per-user allowlist mechanism (e.g., a userId list constraint) are not shown in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented exclusion/denylist of specific users, explicit userId/email allowlist constraint docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
to roll out a feature to 75% of users while granting access to internal users, you can add two activation strategies
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node
A segment is a reusable collection of strategy constraints... you can define a segment once and reuse it across any number of feature flags
